notes.text:
**Archipelago** world for **Ender Magnolia**

## Update
- Logic update
- Added option to shuffle bosses
- Added option to configure number of Steles requirements for Aegis Curio

## Requirements
- [Archipelago](https://github.com/ArchipelagoMW/Archipelago/releases)
- [Ender Magnolia Randomizer](https://github.com/Trexounay/EnderMagnolia.Randomizer/releases/tag/endermagnolia-v0.1.8)

## Current Features
- 340 checks
- 2 Goals: **Ending A** **Ending B**
- Starting Skill option (except non breaking walls weapon)
- Shuffle relic costs
- Progressive Aptitudes
- Start with heal/fast travel
- min/max chapters
- Central Elevator Fix option
- Starting respite

## Notes
This is an early release and has not been extensively tested. Expect bugs and missing features, and please report any issues or feedback.
